name: Ultraloq U-Bolt Pro WiFi (US)

radios.note: U-tec's spec lists standard Bluetooth plus 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n); 5 GHz is not supported. The app reaches the lock over Bluetooth nearby.

matter.note: No Matter statement for this model. Ultraloq's Matter products are a separate Thread-based Bolt Pro, not this lock.

apple_home.note: U-tec's 'Does Ultraloq work with HomeKit?' article says only the Bolt Fingerprint (HomeKit version) and Bolt Fingerprint Matter support HomeKit, and lists the U-Bolt Wi-Fi models with Google Assistant, Alexa, IFTTT and SmartThings instead.

google_home.note: Google Assistant, through the built-in Wi-Fi.

smartthings.note: Ultraloq lists SmartThings for its built-in Wi-Fi locks.

home_assistant.note: Ultraloq's support article ties Home Assistant to the U-Bolt/U-Bolt Pro Z-Wave model, not the Wi-Fi one.

hubRequired.note: Built-in Wi-Fi chip, so the Ultraloq Bridge is not required; U-tec says the Bridge is for the non-Wi-Fi U-Bolt models.

localControl.note: Remote and voice control run through Ultraloq's cloud; local control is not documented.

lockFit.note: Replaces the existing deadbolt; sold as a deadbolt with keypad and fingerprint reader.

keypad.note: Keypad plus fingerprint reader; the spec lists 50 users, 50 codes and 100 fingerprints.

power.note: 6 V from four AA alkaline batteries, with a micro-USB port for emergency power. U-tec gives 3 to 6 months for the Wi-Fi model and up to a year for the non-Wi-Fi versions.

summary: Ultraloq U-Bolt Pro WiFi is a deadbolt replacement with a keypad and fingerprint reader (50 users, 50 codes, 100 fingerprints) and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi built in, so it needs no bridge. Google Assistant, Alexa and SmartThings are supported. U-tec says it does not work with Apple Home, and no Matter statement exists for this model. Four AA cells last 3 to 6 months.
caveats: Wi-Fi is 2.4 GHz only; 5 GHz is not supported.
No Apple Home support; only Ultraloq's Bolt Fingerprint models list HomeKit.
Ultraloq's Matter locks are a separate Thread-based Bolt Pro, not this one.
Home Assistant is documented only for the Z-Wave U-Bolt Pro, so this Wi-Fi model is unconfirmed.
Remote and voice control run through Ultraloq's cloud.
